name: Dating A Muslim
overview: Scripture calls believers to trust in Christ alone, encouraging them not to be troubled but to place their faith in God and Jesus (John 14:1). Loving Christ means obeying His teachings, which are the words of the Father (John 14:24), making obedience to Him central in all relationships. Jesus also prays for believers to be kept from evil while living in the world (John 17:15), highlighting the spiritual protection needed when engaging with those outside the faith, such as Muslims.
